description: This file defines an interface for filesystem operations and related utility functions within the 'filesys' package, including methods for creating, reading, writing, and walking the filesystem, as well as a struct that forwards calls to an underlying filesystem implementation or defaults to the OS filesystem.

classes.name: FileSystem
classes.description: Interface grouping basic filesystem methods such as Create, Mkdir, RemoveAll, Open, IsDir, ReadDir, CleanedAbs, Exists, Glob, ReadFile, WriteFile, Walk.

classes.name: FileSystemOrOnDisk
classes.description: Struct that forwards filesystem method calls to a specified FileSystem or defaults to the OS filesystem if nil.

methods.name: ConfirmDir
methods.description: Validates that a given path is an existing directory, returning a ConfirmedDir or an error.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the internal FileSystem to a specified implementation.

methods.name: fs
methods.description: Returns the current FileSystem, defaulting to the OS filesystem if none is set.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a file at the specified path.

methods.name: Mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: MkdirAll
methods.description: Creates a directory and all necessary parent directories.

methods.name: RemoveAll
methods.description: Removes a path and its contents.

methods.name: IsDir
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory.

methods.name: ReadDir
methods.description: Reads the contents of a directory.

methods.name: CleanedAbs
methods.description: Converts a path into a directory and filename components.

methods.name: Glob
methods.description: Returns matching files for a pattern.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file.

methods.name: Walk
methods.description: Walks the filesystem with a callback function.
